us: Let $u:\mathcal{C}\to\mathcal{D}$ be continuous between sites. Write $u^s:\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal{D})\to\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal{C})$ for restriction of $u^p$ to sheaves, and $u_s:\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal{C})\to\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal{D})$ for the left adjoint formed by sheafifying $u_p$.
I: For a functor $u:\mathcal{C}\to\mathcal{D}$ and object $V$ of $\mathcal{D}$, let $\mathcal{I}^u_V$ have objects $(U,\phi:V\to u(U))$ with arrows $f:U\to U'$ satisfying $u(f)\circ\phi=\phi'$. Its opposite is used for the left Kan-extension indexing.
situation: Let $\mathcal{I}$ be a cofiltered category. For each $i\in\operatorname{Ob}(\mathcal{I})$, let $\mathcal{C}_i$ be a site whose coverings have finite index sets. For each arrow $a:i\to j$ in $\mathcal{I}$, let $f_a:\mathcal{C}_i\to\mathcal{C}_j$ be a morphism of sites determined by continuous $u_a:\mathcal{C}_j\to\mathcal{C}_i$, with $f_a\circ f_b=f_c$ whenever $c=a\circ b$. Let $\mathcal{C}=\operatorname{colim}_i\mathcal{C}_i$ be the site whose coverings are unions of the images of coverings of $\mathcal{C}_i$ under canonical functors $u_i:\mathcal{C}_i\to\mathcal{C}$. The induced morphisms are $f_i:\mathcal{C}\to\mathcal{C}_i$.
pu: Let $u:\mathcal{C}\to\mathcal{D}$ be a functor. For each $V\in\operatorname{Ob}(\mathcal{D})$, let the category $({}_V^u\mathcal{I})$ have objects $(U,\psi:u(U)\to V)$ and arrows $\alpha:(U,\psi)\to(U',\psi')$ with $\psi=\psi'\circ u(\alpha)$. For a presheaf $\mathcal{F}$ on $\mathcal{C}$, define $({}_pu\mathcal{F})(V)=\lim_{({}_V^u\mathcal{I})^{opp}}\mathcal{F}(U)$, with source-defined restriction maps. Let $u^p\mathcal{G}=\mathcal{G}\circ u$. When $u$ is cocontinuous between sites, $({}_su)$ is the same right-adjoint functor restricted to sheaves, by the sheaf preservation lemma.
